title: Exact two-parameter recovery
description: Five points that lie exactly on the line 3 + 2x, with unit standard errors. A correct unregularized solver must return the line back exactly.
assumptions: The response is exactly linear in x, with an intercept.
Every observation has a standard deviation of exactly 1.
limitations: This is synthetic data constructed to lie exactly on a line. Real observations never do.
Because the fit is exact, the residuals are zero and the reduced chi-square is zero, which contradicts the declared unit standard errors. Ordinata says so rather than quietly reporting a perfect fit.

weightedRmseMax.source: The data is exactly linear, so the weighted RMSE must be zero up to rounding.
